newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - ING ups Telerj to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ING ups Telerj to buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it upgraded Rio de Janeiro state telepone company Telerj to buy from hold.
-- It said competition in cellular services will only begin by mid-1998, giving Telerj a lot of time to expand its lines.
-- 1997 will be a turnaround year for Telerj.
-- Telerj will benefit more by a delay in rate restructuring because of higher participation in local calls.
-- ING raises its 12-month price target on Telerj to $180 per 1,000-share lot up from $161.
